notes.title: PoliPlanet Hits #7 on IndieDB
notes.content:
PoliPlanet has reached #7 in popularity on IndieDB and is on the first page of their "Popular Today" section. 

That's [b]#7 out of a whopping 55,505[/b] titles! I'd like to thank everyone for their support and interest in the game. It's truly an incredible feeling to see PoliPlanet next to games such as [i]SCP - Containment Breach[/i], [i]Five Nights at Freddy's[/i], and [i]Gang Beasts[/i]. 

Thank you for your continued support!
